Shreyas Iyer Matches Rohit Sharma's Toss Record

Indian cricketer Shreyas Iyer won his fifth consecutive T20I toss in the third match against England in Nottingham. This achievement places him in a tie with Rohit Sharma for consecutive T20I toss wins. The event is a notable statistical milestone in his captaincy.
